description: List the television stations available for TV search with their market, network, monitoring start date, and monitoring end date — every station by default, or only those matching the optional stations, network, and market filters (each an exact, case-insensitive match; combined with AND). activeCount and totalCount count the returned stations. Stations with an end date within the last 24 hours are flagged as active; stations with earlier end dates are discontinued. Use before querying to verify a station was active during the target time period, or to discover valid station IDs for the stations parameter in other TV tools. Most station monitoring ended October 2024 when the Internet Archive TV feed stopped updating.

market.description: Market to narrow to (e.g. "National", "San Francisco"), matched as a whole value case-insensitively after trimming — "National" does not match "NationalSpecialty". Values come from the market field of the unfiltered list. Blank is ignored.

network.description: Network to narrow to (e.g. "CNN", "ABC"), matched as a whole value case-insensitively after trimming — "FOX" does not match "FOXNEWS". Values come from the network field of the unfiltered list. Blank is ignored.

stations.description: Station IDs to return (e.g. ["CNN", "FOXNEWS", "MSNBC"]) — the IDs the stations parameter of the other TV tools takes. Matches any listed ID, exactly and case-insensitively after trimming; IDs that match no station are named in the notice. Blank entries are ignored; omit it or pass [] to include every station.

name: gdelt_list_tv_stations

activeCount.description: Number of returned stations currently flagged as active.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `gdelt_rate_limited`: GDELT rejected the request for its one-request-per-five-seconds limit, or too many requests were already queued for this one to start in time. `gdelt_unavailable`: GDELT TV API is unreachable or temporarily returned no usable data, including an empty station catalog. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Filter outcome: names the filters when no station matched, and names requested station IDs that are not in the catalog or that another filter excluded. Absent when every requested ID was returned and the result is not empty.

stations.description: Stations matching every supplied filter — all stations when none is given — sorted by station ID.

items.description: A single TV station with monitoring metadata.

endDate.description: Monitoring end date in ISO 8601 format.

isActive.description: True when the end date is within the last 24 hours (recently updated feed). False for discontinued stations.

startDate.description: Monitoring start date in ISO 8601 format.

stationId.description: Station ID used in TV query operators (e.g. "CNN").

totalCount.description: Number of stations returned — the whole catalog when no filter is given.

title: List GDELT TV Stations
